description:
Add regression coverage for desktop ecosystem behavior, not just single-app launch success.

The suite should validate:
- one downloaded app calling another downloaded app through standard discovery
- a downloaded app preferring a downloaded peer over the same scenario running in a local swarm
- mixed local-swarm plus downloaded-app topologies
- core cross-platform interop cases for supported desktop targets
- evidence capture that can feed deployment review and later approval automation

Goal: prove that deployed desktop apps compose like a Vrooli ecosystem when multiple installations coexist.
name: desktop-ecosystem-interop-regression-coverage
title: Build Desktop Ecosystem Interop Regression Coverage
